answer: Each agent must lock a non-transferable stake and submit hardware-attested work receipts, which the ledger samples during a simulated gale of mass registrations. Sybils then pay the full bond for every fake identity, while a velvet reputation layer lets honest newcomers borrow trust from established peers. Fail a random audit and the bond is forfeited, turning that identity into a cautionary relic and making sock-puppetry economically irrational.
